caseName: Arizona School Choice Trust v. Winn
caseNameFull: Arizona School Choice Trust v. Kathleen M. Winn

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The Court reversed the judgment below in Ariz. Christian Sch. Tuition Org. v. Winn, 563 U.S. 125, 131 S. Ct. 1436, 179 L. Ed. 2d 523 (2011). Therefore, petition for a writ of certiorari granted, and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for further proceedings.

Same case below, 562 F.3d 1002.
